auth.alreadyRegistered: There is already an account with that email. Try signing in instead.
auth.confirmSent: Almost there — confirm your account from the email we sent to {email}.
auth.createLead: Email and a password, nothing else. We send one confirmation link and that is it.
auth.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
auth.googleNotEnabled: Google sign-in is not switched on for this project yet.
auth.metaSignInDescription: Sign in to sync your OnePlay account.
auth.metaSignUpDescription: Create a OnePlay account with an email and a password.
auth.notConfirmed: That email is not confirmed yet — check your inbox for the confirmation link.
auth.signInLead: Your scores stay on this device. Signing in is for the parts of the Hub that live in the cloud.

disc.analogBody: L1 + R1 + Select toggles the analog mode light
disc.controlsLead: A plugged-in gamepad works as a DualShock with no setup at all — press any button on it once and the browser hands it over. On a phone or tablet an on-screen pad appears over the stage instead, sticks and all. On the keyboard the pad maps onto these keys, and the stage has to be focused, so click it once after powering on.
disc.memoryCardBody: Saved to this browser on pause and on exit
disc.metaDescription: A PlayStation disc running on the pcsx_rearmed core, in the browser.
disc.missingBody: Discs live in the browser that added them — they do not follow you between devices or survive clearing site data.
disc.missingTitle: That disc is not in this browser
disc.saveStatesBody: Three slots per disc, above the pad
disc.touchBody: On-screen pad, diagonals included — stays put in fullscreen

footer.blurb: A cloud library of eight arcade titles. No install, no download — pick a game and the round starts in the browser.
footer.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Sony Interactive Entertainment

game.gamepadNote: A connected gamepad is detected automatically — D-pad moves, the bottom face button acts, Options pauses.

home.ctaBody: Nothing to download, nothing to sign up for. Open a game and the console boots in the tab.
home.ctaTitle: Your next round is one click away
home.libraryTitle: Eight games, every one playable right now
home.pickUp: Pick up where you left off
home.roomHint: Point at a picture to see the game — click to open it
home.roomHintTouch: Tap a picture to open the game
home.step1Body: Browse by genre or jump into whatever you played last. Every game page shows its controls before you commit.
home.step2Body: The session loads in the page. Plug in a controller and it is detected automatically — otherwise use the keyboard or on-screen pad.
home.step3Body: Bronze, silver and gold targets per game. Personal bests and playtime are stored on this device — no account required.
home.threeSteps: Three steps between you and the first round

library.devNote: Dev note: serving the bundled catalogue — run supabase/migrations/0001_games.sql to read from Supabase.
library.lead: {count} titles, all instantly playable. Filter down to the genre you are in the mood for, or search by name and studio.
library.metaDescription: Browse the full catalogue. Filter by genre, sort by rating or personal best, and start any title instantly.
library.noMatchBody: Try a different name, or clear the filters to see the whole catalogue.
library.psxBody: Disc images stay on this device — they are never uploaded, and they do not follow you to another browser.
library.savedBody: Saved titles appear first on your profile. Add one from any game page.
library.title: Every game in the library

meta.description: A cloud library of arcade titles. Pick a game, press start, play in the browser. No install, no download.
meta.title: OnePlay — play instantly in your browser

notFound.body: The page you were after is not in this library. It may have been renamed, or the link was mistyped.
notFound.metaDescription: That page is not in the library.
notFound.title: Disc not found

play.keyboardBody: Arrows or WASD, Space to act
play.startHint: Enter to start · Esc to pause

ports.defaultHint: Leave everything on “Not used” and the browser’s own order decides. The choice is kept on this device.
ports.heading: Who is player one
ports.none: No controller yet. Press a button on one — a browser keeps a pad hidden until it has been used.
ports.savedHint: Saved — power the console off and on for the new ports to take effect.
ports.title: Controller ports

profile.metaDescription: Your rounds, trophies and personal bests, kept on this device.
profile.nothingSavedBody: Open any game page and hit “Add to library” to keep it here.
profile.subFresh: Local profile · no rounds played yet

psx.arcadeBody: The eight built-in canvas games need no files at all.
psx.arcadeTitle: The arcade is still one click away
psx.biosBody: Without a dump the core emulates the BIOS itself, which is enough for most games. A real dump (scph5501.bin and friends) fixes the stubborn ones and gives you the boot animation.
psx.cloudPlaytimeEmpty: Nothing tracked yet — it fills in after your first session while signed in.
psx.confirmRemoveCopied: Remove {title} and its save states from this browser?
psx.confirmRemoveLinked: Remove {title} from the shelf? The files on disk are left alone; save states go.
psx.copied: {title} is on the shelf ({size} copied into this browser).
psx.driveBody: Signs in with your own Google account and downloads straight from Drive to this browser — we never see the file. Pick a .cue and its tracks together.
psx.driveDevNote: Dev note: set NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / _API_KEY / _APP_ID to offer Google Drive imports.
psx.drivePickedNotADisc: Nothing you picked looks like a PlayStation disc. Expected {formats}.
psx.driveSkipped: {count} of the picked files were not disc data and were left out.
psx.driveTitle: Pull a disc out of Google Drive
psx.fairPlayBody: OnePlay ships no games and no BIOS. Bring dumps of discs you own, or homebrew that is free to distribute.
psx.heroLead: The pcsx_rearmed core runs as WebAssembly right here on the page. Point it at a disc image you own and it boots — no install, no upload. Files stay in this browser.
psx.heroTitle: Play your PlayStation discs in the browser
psx.insertBody: Pick a .cue together with its .bin tracks, or a single .chd / .pbp file. Multi-disc games work through an .m3u.
psx.linkFolderBody: The whole shelf at once, read straight off disk. Nothing is copied, so a 600 MB game is on the shelf in a second and costs no browser storage. Your browser will ask for access to that folder again each session.
psx.linkFolderTitle: Link the folder your discs live in
psx.linked: Linked {count} discs from {folder} — nothing was copied.
psx.linkedNothingNew: Everything under {folder} is already on the shelf.
psx.metaDescription: Run real PlayStation discs in the browser. Add a disc image you own and it boots on the pcsx_rearmed core — nothing is uploaded.
psx.noArchives: Archives are not supported — extract the disc image first, then add the .cue and .bin together.
psx.notADisc: Nothing here looks like a PlayStation disc. Expected {formats}.
psx.rawBinNote: That is a raw .bin with no .cue — single-track dumps usually boot, multi-track ones need the cue sheet too.
psx.shelfEmpty: Nothing here yet. Add a disc image above and it shows up on this shelf, with its own save states and memory card.
psx.stillNoAccess: {title} still has no access to its folder.
psx.storageNote: Linked discs cost no storage — only the copied ones do. Either way the shelf lives in this browser: clearing site data empties it, and linked folders forget their permission.

settings.confirmEraseAll: Erase every score, trophy, saved game and preference on this device?
settings.confirmResetScores: Reset all personal bests, playtime and round counts?
settings.difficultyNote: A preference only — each title still tunes its own difficulty curve.
settings.displayBody: How the stage renders during a session.
settings.eraseNote: Erasing removes bests, trophies, playtime and settings from this device. It cannot be undone.
settings.gameplayBody: Defaults applied when a new session starts.
settings.hapticsBody: Where the connected pad supports it
settings.lead: Everything here is stored on this device only. No account, no sync, nothing leaves the browser.
settings.metaDescription: Profile, gameplay, display and stored data — all kept on this device.
settings.profileBody: The name shown on your profile card and score board.
settings.showFpsBody: Adds an FPS readout to the session bar
settings.storedDataBody: Scores, playtime, trophies and your saved library live in this browser.
settings.title: Settings

stage.bootWithBios: Booting through your own BIOS dump.
stage.bootWithHle: No BIOS installed — booting on the core’s built-in HLE BIOS. Add a dump on the PlayStation page if a game refuses to start.
stage.errorCore: The emulator core could not be loaded. Run `npm run psx:core` so it lands in public/cores, then reload.
stage.errorDeclined: {message} — press Power on again to retry.
stage.errorMemory: The browser ran out of memory for the core. Close other tabs and try again.
stage.powerHint: Esc to pause · Enter is Start
